def flood_fill(grid, start_pos, visited=None):
    """Return size of connected component starting from start_pos"""
    if visited is None:
        visited = set()
    i, j = start_pos
    
    def dfs(pi, pj):
        visited.add((pi, pj))
        size = 1

def get_all_components(grid):
    """Get all connected components with their sizes"""
